STYLE OF CAUSE: Osei v. Manitoba Public Insurance Corporation
CITATION: 2022 MBCA 58
COURT: Court of Appeal of Manitoba
DOCKET: AI22-30-09876
DATE: 2022-10-27

BACKGROUND
[1] The appellant was injured in a motor vehicle accident and applied for income replacement benefits.
[2] The Corporation denied the claim on the basis that the appellant's injuries were pre-existing.

STANDARD OF REVIEW
[3] The Commission's factual findings are entitled to deference and are reviewed for palpable and overriding error.

ANALYSIS
[4] The Commission's finding that the injury was pre-existing was open to it on the medical evidence before it.
[5] There is no palpable and overriding error in the Commission's assessment.

DISPOSITION
[6] The appeal is dismissed with costs to the respondent.
